steps.content: The world grinds to an absolute halt. In the same instant, every code strip plummets, scattering across the ground like so much worthless trash.
Seizing the opportunity, chaotic spectral shadows surge forward. They pour through the fracture in a cacophony of sharp, distorted whispers, a crushing tide that slams into you and Hilda.

steps.speaker: Chaotic Voice
steps.content: Your plan has failed... You've been abandoned... ${PlayerName} has betrayed you... Your ideals are doomed...

steps.speaker: Chaotic Voice
steps.content: You took the wrong path... And you think you can just turn back...? No one will allow it...

steps.speaker: Chaotic Voice
steps.content: You have always failed... of course you fail again this time...
With a shrill, piercing screech, the contamination and Mania return. It bores into her, twisting and tearing her apart from the inside.
She doesn't even try to fight it this time.

A sludge-like wave of Mania seizes your legs, crawling up your body with terrifying speed. Your shout is swallowed by the chaos, but you fight through it, grabbing her shoulders and screaming her name with every ounce of your strength.

steps.speaker: Chaotic Voice
steps.content: Futile, futile... I am her true destiny...

steps.speaker: Chaotic Voice
steps.content: SHE IS MINE...!!!
[Shackles Red Flash]

A crimson flare from the shackles cuts through the horde of wailing shadows. Their forms scatter and dissolve into shrieks as the world itself comes apart. The sky shatters, and the ground crumbles into nothing. Together, you are plunged into the waiting void.
[Scene: Meadow]

steps.speaker: Young Hilda
steps.content: The city-state is like a giant bonfire, burning bright to keep every home warm and every belly full! It's not just big walls and tall lighthouses... it's hope for everyone!

steps.speaker: Young Hilda
steps.content: One day, I'll add my own little spark to that fire. I'll shine my light for others to see.

steps.speaker: Young Hilda
steps.content: You will too, right?

steps.speaker: Young Hilda
steps.content: You're me from the future, all grown up! Can you answer my question now?

steps.speaker: Young Hilda
steps.content: Did you become a light for everyone? Did you make other people's lives brighter?

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: ...I got lost on the wrong path... and walked it for a very long time.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: I thought I was protecting something precious, but in the end, I only caused ruin... I failed the people who believed in me.

steps.speaker: Young Hilda
steps.content: Really? That's quite sad!

steps.speaker: Young Hilda
steps.content: But you'll get back up again, right? If one path leads to a dead end, you just find another! If that one's no good either, then try the next one! If you try every single path, you're sure to find the right one!
With a smile, she steps forward, her hand closing around yours, and pulls you into a run down one of the waiting paths.
But the ground itself is alive with deception. The paths beneath her feet branch and weave like veins, each one promising light while secretly leading into a deeper, more profound darkness.
So where did the corruption begin?
Which of these forking, illusory roads is the true one? Where do you go?

steps.speaker: Marlo
steps.content: You, an undercover agent? Don't make me laugh. You don't have the stomach for the killing it takes.

steps.speaker: Marlo
steps.content: We had a deal. I handle the wetwork, you handle the codes. Let's keep it that way.

steps.speaker: Marlo
steps.content: Don't you ever kill anyone, Hilda. You'll regret it. I'm telling you, no matter what happens, keep your hands clean.

steps.speaker: Manphist
steps.content: Will you join me, Hilda? The war is all but over. The metropoles' defeat is inevitable.

steps.speaker: Manphist
steps.content: My allegiance to Fraser was never about loyalty, but utility. Self-interest is the only constant.

steps.speaker: Manphist
steps.content: You're my most gifted student. You could have access to far more intelligence than you do now. You could be shaping policy from the top, not wasting your talent in this grinding stalemate, going down with a corpse of a city-state!

steps.speaker: Hartleins
steps.content: I'm sorry, my dear, but we can't bring you. DisCity is too dangerous. We can't let you face that.

steps.speaker: Hartleins
steps.content: Stay here. Leave the ciphers behind. Forget the war. Give up on your ideals. Just live an ordinary life.

steps.speaker: Hartleins
steps.content: Wait for us to end this... I promise we will come back for you.

steps.speaker: Crowd
steps.content: DisCity won! We've won the war! To hell with those metropole bastards! Hahahaha!!

steps.speaker: Crowd
steps.content: Purge the defeatists! Purge the opportunists! Purge the spies! Make every traitor pay!

steps.speaker: Crowd
steps.content: Root them all out!! Root them all out!!
(All options completed)

steps.speaker: Sinister Voice
steps.content: Hahahahahahaha! This is who you are. Always choosing the wrong path.

steps.speaker: Sinister Voice
steps.content: Betrayed by allies, abandoned by the times, your efforts wasted, every choice mocked by fate.

steps.speaker: Sinister Voice
steps.content: Your ideals were never realized. They never will be.
[Manor Exterior]
The vision shatters, leaving you stranded once more in the familiar grounds of the manor. But the bone-chilling rain has warped the estate into a distorted reflection of itself.
She stands bewildered at the far end of the eaves, her gaze tracing the countless wrong paths that coil and twist beneath her feet like serpents.
Then, cutting through the drum of the rain, you hear a soft, disbelieving laugh.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: You knew all along? Is that why you've been giving me that look?! Because you think I'm pitiful? That I'm pathetic?

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: Did you come just to witness my disgrace...?

Decades spent in the shadows, enduring for this single moment. She marshaled every ounce of her strength, launched an all-out attack, and found the one weakness she sought—yet now, at the moment of her triumph, it all crumbles into dust.
She has lost to time, or rather... to fate.
The rain obscures your sight, yet it cannot hide the profound despair and sorrow drowning her eyes.

Around you, the tide of Mania roars, swallowing the manor whole. The ground beneath your feet is the last bastion, a crumbling precipice poised to plunge into the swirling swamp of madness at any second.
Her rampage is absolute. Nothing now can calm the storm but your shackles.
And so, you step through the tempest, closing the final distance between you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: At first, my only goal was to extract information. I fabricated an identity, entered your mind, deceived you, protected you, grew close to you, all for the mission.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I planned to take what I needed and leave. But I found you weren't just a spy. Your torment came from your conscience. You struggled because you couldn't forget the sacrifices. You were always searching for another way, even when you took the wrong turns.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: When you gave me the Monolith... I truly wanted to help you.

Had this not been a memory washed by rain, but a page from true history, you might have truly helped her. You could have helped her complete the infiltration and stand in defiance against the metropoles.
Whatever the outcome, her story would have found a different end.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Because you can still hear the echo deep within your heart, calling you to a new path.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: As long as you can hear it, you are not truly lost.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I believe a soul like yours deserves another chance. You can still choose your path again.
(Paths converge)

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: ...Again? What's the point?
Her words are a low whisper, barely audible over the sudden roar of the Mania flood. A wave of pure darkness crashes into you, its force threatening to sweep you away.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: Can someone like me really have another chance?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That choice is yours.
Every force in the space conspires to hold you back, yet with every step, your determination only grows stronger.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Today, DisCity walks the same path the metropoles once did. During the military regime, countless satellite towns were crushed, and countless Outlanders died by DisCorps's hand. If accomplices share guilt, then I bear it too.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: No one can promise they will never make the wrong choice.

You finally manage to grasp her, but she is a statue, yielding yet distant. Uncontrolled Mania flows from her like a wound, crystallizing into cruel barbs that pierce through her own flesh. The black essence drips steadily, feeding the contamination pooling at her feet.

Your shackles instinctively reach out to calm her Mania, only to be met by an invisible, iron resistance—the sheer force of her despair. Recognizing this is a battle of wills, you take her hand and press it firmly to your brow.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I know you don't believe me... So come, see for yourself.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Your power won't lie to you. Look into my memories and judge my words for yourself.
At your invitation, deeper memories unfold before her.
[The Rust]
Within them lies a poignant sorrow.
[Syndicate]
A rage born of desperation.
[West District]
A rising, unified resolve.
[Undercurrent] (or event story image, with multiple characters)
Darkness that lurks beneath the surface.
And the throes of the world.
Her gaze lingers on the diverse faces within your memories.
In essence, they are no different from people of the past—strong yet vulnerable, foolish yet brilliant—all chasing their own ideals in the corners of the city-state.
Yet the same shadows... now loom like colossal beasts emerging from behind DisCity itself.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The Independence War is over. History has already passed its judgment. We don't have to remain enemies because of the sides our city-states were on.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So this isn't about serving another's mission. It's about following your own conviction. Ask yourself, were you truly devoted to the "metropole," or to that ideal city-state in your heart?
These memories, raw and razor-sharp, pierce through her nearly numb senses.
Is this the "future"? Not the "past," not the "present"?

She once believed her loyalty was to the metropole itself. Now, a doubt pierces her: was it ever the city-state? Or was it the gleaming ideal of what it could be, not the rotting carcass it had become?

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: ...You really are a kind person, but...
Her hand trembles as she reaches for you—
As if to obstruct the moment, a cacophonous tide surges from behind, violently slamming you both into the pitch-black Mania swamp.
